title: Release history attempt report
description: A file's `<panel>/attempts/<digest>.json` (`release_history/cli.py`, `AttemptReport`): how the latest attempt at a file ended when it stored nothing. Replaced at each attempt, removed once the point or a stored gap is written; finalize reads it into the manifest's state for the file. Version 1: every key listed here is required and no other key is allowed. A key added later is declared here with the version that added it, and is not required, so the documents already written stay valid and no format version moves.

digest.description: The file's sha256, as the series listed it.

status.description: `interrupted`: written before each stage and never replaced, so the run died there; `failed`: rewritten after a handled failure.
